title: Sakshi Bhav — Vistar Se
subtitle: Roz ki zindagi ke beech Sakshi Bhav
author: Aadisatv

sections.heading: Pratham Khand — Jeevan ke Beech Sakshi Bhav
sections.content:
## Pichhle Adhyayon se Aage

Pehle adhyay me sadhak ne andar ki taraf dekha. Sharir dekha, mann dekha, anubhavkarta dekha, aur phir us shant jaanne wali upasthiti ki taraf ishara paya jise is course me Sakshi kaha gaya. Dusre adhyay me sadhak ne bahar ki taraf dekha: jagat, naam-roop aur Maya. Ab teesre adhyay ka prashn bahut practical hai: is samajh ko jeevan ke har mod par kaise zinda rakha jaye?

Shant baithkar padhte samay Sakshi Bhav samajh me aa sakta hai. Lekin phir life chalti hai. Koi bolta hai. Koi rishta hurt karta hai. Koi kaam bigadta hai. Koi ichchha uthti hai. Dar aata hai. Success milti hai, failure aata hai. Tab sadhak aksar anubhavkarta me laut jata hai: “Mere saath aisa hua”, “Mujhe chot lagi”, “Main fail ho gaya.”

Isliye ab Sakshi Bhav ko sirf idea ki tarah nahi, balki real zindagi ke beech dekhna hai.

## Bhram: Sakshi Bhav Sirf Dhyan me Hota Hai

Bahut sadhak sochte hain ki Sakshi Bhav sirf shant room me, aankhen band karke, meditation me aata hai. Dhyan useful hai, par yeh samajh adhuri hai.

Sakshi Bhav har pal available hai — chalte hue, bolte hue, sunte hue, khana khate hue, kaam karte hue, gusse me bhi, khushi me bhi. Sakshi koi special state nahi hai. Sakshi vah shant jaanne wali upasthiti hai jo har state ko jaanti hai. Mann shant hai — jaana ja raha hai. Mann ashant hai — yeh bhi jaana ja raha hai.

Sakshi Bhav ko sirf meditation tak limit karna aisa hai jaise koi kahe ki light sirf puja room me hai, baaki ghar me nahi. Jaanne ki upasthiti har experience me hai.

## Sakshi Bhav aur Concentration me Farq

Sakshi Bhav ka matlab tense alertness nahi hai. Yeh koi inner guard nahi hai jo har thought ko pakadta rahe. Yeh sahaj jaanana hai.

Aankh dekhne ke liye mehnat nahi karti. Aankh khuli ho aur light ho, to dekhna apne aap hota hai. Isi tarah Sakshi sahaj jaanta hai. Thought aaya — jaana gaya. Emotion uthi — jaani gayi. Sharir me thakan aayi — jaani gayi.

Kamre me pankha chal raha hai. Jab tak dhyan nahi jata, awaaz background me rehti hai. Jaise hi koi kehta hai, “Pankhe ki awaaz suno”, pata chalta hai ki awaaz pehle se thi. Use banana nahi pada. Dhyan sirf lauta. Sakshi Bhav bhi aisa hi hai.

## Teen Jagah Jahan Sakshi Bhav Bhoolta Hai

Pehli jagah hai rishte. Apne vyakti ki baat zyada chot deti hai, kyonki usme expectations, memories aur identity judi hoti hain.

Dusri jagah hai kaam aur result. Success aayi to anubhavkarta kehta hai — “Main successful hoon.” Failure aaya to kehta hai — “Main failure hoon.”

Teesri jagah hai gehri emotions. Dar, dukh, krodh, irshya aur akelapan uthte hain to sadhak bhool jata hai ki emotion jaani ja rahi hai.

## Sakshi Bhav Practice Nahi, Wapasi Hai

Sakshi Bhav ko keval practice bana doge to mann ise achievement bana dega. Isliye yahan ise wapasi kahenge. Wapasi ka matlab hai — jo pehle se hai, usi ki taraf lautna. Sakshi pehle se hai. Jaanana pehle se hai. Dhyan experience me ulajh gaya tha, ab wapas aa raha hai.

Thoughts me uljho, wapas lauto. Emotion me baho, wapas lauto. Praise me phoolo ya criticism me sikudo, wapas lauto. Bhoolna purani aadat hai. Lautna sadhana hai.

## Aaj ke liye Abhyas

Aaj ek simple activity chuno — chai peena, khana, chalna, seedhiyan chadhna, haath dhona ya chhoti baat-cheet. Beech me teen baar dekho:

**“Yeh kriya ho rahi hai.”**  
**“Sharir ise kar raha hai.”**  
**“Koi ise jaan raha hai.”**

Jaanne ko pakadne ki koshish mat karo. Bas pehchano ki experience ho raha hai aur jaana ja raha hai.

sections.heading: Dvitiya Khand — Rishton me Sakshi Bhav
sections.content:
## Rishte Sabse Badi Pariksha Hain

Rishton me mann jaldi react karta hai. Koi apna kuch keh de, to andar lehar uthti hai — dukh, gussa, dar, apmaan, expectation. Bahar se baat chhoti ho sakti hai, andar gehri lagti hai.

Rishte Sakshi Bhav ki pariksha bhi hain aur sambhavna bhi. Pariksha isliye ki yahan anubhavkarta jaldi active hota hai. Sambhavna isliye ki agar yahan Sakshi Bhav aa jaye, to purani uljhanen dheeli hone lagti hain.

## Chot Gehri Kyon Lagti Hai

Ajnabi kuch kathor bole to thodi chidh uthti hai aur chali jaati hai. Lekin wahi baat apna vyakti bole to chot gehri lagti hai. Kyonki close relationships me shabdon ke saath expectations, old memories, recognition ki ichchha aur prem ki chah judi hoti hai.

Koi apna kahe, “Tum kabhi nahi samajhte”, to andar story uth sakti hai — “Main itna karta hoon, phir bhi mujhe nahi samjha gaya.” Bahar ek sentence aaya, andar anubhavkarta ne poori kahani bana li.

Sakshi chot ko deny nahi karta. Vah jaanta hai — “Chot ka anubhav uth raha hai.”

## Sunne me Sakshi Bhav

Aam taur par hum sach me sunte nahi. Koi bolta hai aur hum andar jawab banana shuru kar dete hain. Sadhak ka pehla step hai: samne wale ko sunna aur saath me apni reaction ko dekhna.

Samne words aa rahe hain. Andar defense uth raha hai. Dono ko dekhna hi sunne me Sakshi Bhav hai. Iska matlab chup rehna nahi; iska matlab response dena hai, par dekhne ke baad.

## Teekhi Baat-cheet me Thehraav

Kathor baat sunte hi sharir tight ho sakta hai, saans badal sakti hai, mann defend karna chahta hai. Isi jagah chhota thehraav bahut kaam karta hai.

Bina Sakshi Bhav:

Vyakti A: “Tum kabhi meri baat sunte hi nahi.”  
Vyakti B: “Achha? Tum khud kab sunte ho?”  
Vyakti A: “Dekha, phir bahas.”  
Vyakti B: “Kyonki tum hamesha blame karte ho.”

Sakshi Bhav ke saath:

Vyakti A: “Tum kabhi meri baat sunte hi nahi.”  
Vyakti B reaction mehsoos karta hai, ek saans rukta hai.  
Vyakti B: “Mere andar defense uth raha hai, par main samajhna chahta hoon — tumhe kis baat me aisa laga?”  
Vyakti A: “Jab main baat kar rahi thi, tum phone dekh rahe the.”  
Vyakti B: “Theek hai, yeh main dekh sakta hoon.”

Yahan koi hara nahi. Reaction dekhi gayi, phir clarity se response aaya.

## Anubhavkarta ki Chot ko Naam Dena

Koi tumhe ignore kare to dekho — “Abhi vah ‘main’ uth raha hai jise importance chahiye.” Koi criticism kare — “Vah ‘main’ uth raha hai jise sahi sabit hona hai.” Koi expectation poori na kare — “Vah ‘main’ uth raha hai jo prem ko apni ichchha ke hisaab se chahta hai.”

Chot ko naam dena use dabana nahi hai. Naam dene se space khulta hai. Space thandapan nahi, clarity hai.

## Prem aur Pakad

Hum pakad ko prem samajh lete hain. “Tum mere hisaab se chalo kyonki main tumse prem karta hoon.” Isme kabhi-kabhi dar aur control hota hai.

Prem me komalta hai. Pakad me dar hai. Prem doosre ko dekhta hai. Pakad doosre ko apne hisaab se banana chahti hai. Sakshi Bhav prem ko thanda nahi karta; use saaf karta hai.

## Aaj ke liye Abhyas

Aaj ek baat-cheet ko observe karo:

**Maine sach me suna ya jawab banata raha?**  
**Kis sentence par anubhavkarta active hua?**  
**Kaunsi chot ya ichchha uthi — samman, samjha jana, sahi sabit hona ya prem?**

sections.heading: Tritiya Khand — Kaam, Prayas aur Results me Sakshi Bhav
sections.content:
## Kaam ke Kshetra me Dekhna

Kaam me anubhavkarta result se identity jod leta hai. Kaam achha hua to kehta hai — “Main successful hoon.” Kaam bigda to kehta hai — “Main failure hoon.” Praise mili to “main capable hoon”, criticism aaya to “main incapable hoon.”

Kaam karna sadhana ke khilaf nahi. Responsibility zaroori hai. Lekin result ko apna antim swaroop maan lena dukh ki shuruaat hai.

## Result se Identity

Exam, project, business, job, praise, rejection — ye sab events hain. Anubhavkarta inhe identity bana leta hai.

Student ke marks kam aaye. Event simple hai: marks kam aaye. Par anubhavkarta kehta hai — “Main fail hoon.” Business nahi chala. Event hai: result unfavorable tha. Par anubhavkarta kehta hai — “Main yogya nahi hoon.”

Pain result se kam aur result ko “main” banane se zyada aata hai. Sakshi Bhav dekhta hai — result aaya, disappointment uthi, sharir heavy hai, future ki chinta hai, aur yeh sab jaana ja raha hai.

## Mehnat aur Result Alag Hain

Sakshi Bhav mehnat chhodna nahi sikhata. Yeh aalasya nahi hai. Yeh kehta hai — kaam poori eemandari se karo, prepare karo, seekho, improve karo, responsibility nibhao; par result ko apni final identity ka proof mat banao.

Mehnat tumhare haath me hai, result kai factors se banta hai. Kisaan beej bota hai aur mehnat karta hai, par baarish aur mausam uske haath me nahi. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki vah kaam chhod de. Vah clarity se kaam karta hai.

## Project Bigad Gaya

Kisi ne office project par bahut mehnat ki. Presentation me client satisfied nahi hua. Project ruk gaya.

Bina Sakshi Bhav, anubhavkarta kehta hai — “Main kharab hoon”, “Meri capacity kam hai.” Sakshi Bhav me vah dekhta hai — project bigda, nirasha uthi, criticism se chot lagi, image ki chinta uth rahi hai. Phir clarity aati hai — “Galti hui hai. Seekhna hai. Lekin yeh mere poore astitva ka decision nahi.”

Ab practical learning possible hai.

## Comparison ka Jaal

“Usne mujhse zyada kamaya”, “Vah aage nikal gaya”, “Main peeche hoon.” Comparison thoughts common hain. Sakshi Bhav unhe force se nahi rokta. Vah kehta hai — “Comparison ka thought uth raha hai. Mann meri value dusre se naap raha hai.”

Comparison thought problem nahi; use identity banana bondage hai. Inspiration me learning energy hai. Comparison me kami ka dard hai.

## Failure ke Baad Uthna

Failure aaye to pehle dukh ko space do. Dar, shame, heaviness ko dekho. Sadhana dukh ko mitane ki trick nahi; use jaanne ki clarity hai.

Business band ho gaya. Anubhavkarta kehta hai — “Main failed hoon.” Sakshi Bhav dekhta hai — “Business nahi chala. Dukh hai. Par yeh meri poori identity nahi. Yeh ek experience aur lesson hai.” Jab identity nahi tootati, learning possible hoti hai.

## Success me Sajagta

Success me bhi Sakshi Bhav zaroori hai. Joy ko dabao mat. Gratitude rakho. Lekin ego ko dekho — “Main bahut bada hoon”, “Sab mere karan hua.” Sakshi Bhav success ka aanand lene se nahi rokta; vah dikhata hai ki success bhi anubhav hai.

## Aaj ke liye Abhyas

Recent success ya failure yaad karo:

**Event kya tha?**  
**Anubhavkarta ne kaunsi identity banayi?**  
**Agar ise lesson ki tarah dekhein, to next clear step kya hai?**

sections.heading: Chaturth Khand — Gehri Emotions me Sakshi Bhav aur Samapan
sections.content:
## Emotions ki Gehraai

Jab dar, dukh, krodh, irshya, akelapan ya insecurity teevra uthe, sadhak aksar beh jata hai. Sakshi Bhav emotion ko deny karna nahi, usse bhagna nahi, aur spiritual words se dhakna nahi. Sakshi Bhav ka arth hai — emotion ko honestly jaanana, par use final identity na banana.

## Emotion Aati Hai, Par Tum Keval Emotion Nahi

Emotion sharir me bhi feel hoti hai. Dar me chest tight ho sakti hai. Krodh me heat aa sakti hai. Dukh me heaviness ho sakti hai. Emotion real lagti hai, aur experience ke level par real hai. Use jhooth mat kaho.

Par dekho — kya emotion permanent hai? Dar aaya aur badla. Krodh utha aur shant hua. Dukh halka hua. Sakshi Bhav dekhta hai — “Dar uth raha hai”, “Dukh ka anubhav ho raha hai”, “Krodh ki lehar hai.”

## Dar ko Dekhna

Dar future story banata hai — “Agar sab bigad gaya to?” Pehla step hai naam dena: “Dar uth raha hai. Future imagination chal rahi hai. Sharir tight hai.” Phir pucho: abhi sach me kya ho raha hai? Kya danger present hai ya mann future bana raha hai?

## Dukh ko Dekhna

Dukh ka samman karo. Spirituality ke naam par use halka mat karo. Sakshi Bhav dukh ko “sab Maya hai” kehkar nahi hatata. Vah kehta hai — “Dukh hai, aur yeh jaana ja raha hai.” Aansu aayein to unhe bhi jaano.

## Krodh ko Dekhna

Krodh fast emotion hai. Vah turant react karna chahta hai. Krodh me energy hai; use sirf bura kehkar dabao mat. Sakshi Bhav dekhta hai — “Krodh uth raha hai. Sharir me garmi hai. Jawab dene ki ichchha hai.” Krodh uthna ek baat hai, usse turant bol dena dusri. Krodh ko dekhkar clarity se bolna teesri sambhavna hai.

## Emotion aur Story Alag Hain

Emotion direct feeling hai. Story mann banata hai. Dukh utha, story bani — “Mere saath hamesha aisa hota hai.” Dar utha, story bani — “Sab bigad jayega.” Sakshi Bhav dono ko alag dekhna sikhata hai.

## Emotionless Hona Lakshya Nahi

Sakshi Bhav ka arth emotionless hona nahi. Emotions uthenge. Goal emotions ko marna nahi, emotions ke beech khud ko na bhoolna hai. Sakshi Bhav space deta hai. Anubhavkarta bandh jata hai.

## Pure Adhyay ka Saar

Is adhyay me humne dekha: Sakshi Bhav sirf dhyan me nahi, life ke har moment me hai. Rishton me: sunna, rukna, chot ko pehchanna. Kaam me: mehnat karna, par result ko identity na banana. Emotions me: emotion ko dabaye bina jaanana.

Sakshi Bhav life se alag nahi. Sakshi Bhav life ke beech yaad rakhne ki kala hai.

## Agle Adhyay ki Or

Agle adhyay me hum ahankar ki paraton ko dekhenge — vah “main” jo sharir, mann, role, success, chot, thought aur story se identity banata hai. Ahankar sirf ghamand nahi; mool galat pehchan hai — “Main sharir-mann hoon.”

## Samapan

Sakshi Bhav door ki manzil nahi. Yeh us jaanne wali upasthiti ki taraf lautna hai jo har anubhav me pehle se hai. Tumhe life chhodni nahi. Emotions mitani nahi. Rishton se bhagna nahi. Kaam se udasin nahi hona. Sirf in sabke beech khud ko na bhoolna hai.

Dekhna hi lautna hai. Lautna hi sadhana hai.

## Is Saptah ke liye Abhyas

Agle saat din jab bhi koi teekhi emotion uthe, ruko aur dekho:

**Sharir me yeh kahan mehsoos ho rahi hai?**  
**Mann iske upar kaunsi story bana raha hai?**  
**Kya main ise experience ki tarah jaan raha hoon, ya identity bana raha hoon?**

Dheere se kaho: **“Yeh emotion uth rahi hai. Yeh jaani ja rahi hai. Main ise dekh sakta hoon.”**
